'''Vor Essen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of [[Phylus Mon]].

==Biography==
In advance of the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of the neighboring [[The galaxy/Legends|"Skyriver"]] [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] Vor Essen and his brother [[Kor Essen|Kor]] were sent to infiltrate the galaxy's world of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and organized crime. Enamored by the lifestyle they adopted, the brothers abandoned their mission.<ref name="TFW" />

Eventually, Kor and Vor Essen were captured by [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] slaver [[Phylus Mon]] in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[A Mon Alone]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> and imprisoned in Mon's slave zoo on board the ''[[Animiasma]]''. They were eager to escape.

The Essens, should they find any would-be rescuers, would try to bribe them with self-made [[Tehk'la blade]]s or electromesh armor, because they believed that every sentient would be motivated by material goods instead of abstract morals.

Phylus Mon surgically inserted an explosive near the heart of each of his slaves. The explosive would be activated in the case of Phylus Mon's death, but it could also be deactivated with the impact of an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion weapon]]. All the slaves in Phylus Mon's zoo were also regularly battered.

The abuse they suffered under Mon led the brothers to reconsider their place in the galaxy's society. Escaping with fellow captives shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kor and Vor returned to their mission and continued gathering intelligence for the planned attack.<ref name="TFW" />
